title: Bootstrap default blue as the primary on navbar and button
evidence: `.navbar` and `.btn-primary` carry Bootstrap 5's stock primary `#0d6efd` (lines 3, 8, 9) with the stock hover ramp `#0b5ed7` / `#0a58ca` (14-15) and the stock border grey `#dee2e6` (19, 23). `#0d6efd` measures oklch(0.578 0.228 260.0), inside the AI purple family window (hue 255-325, chroma >= 0.15) and 0.2 degrees from Tailwind blue-500, and it is the primary fill three times. Every colour in the file is a library default and none is a decision. Aliases: section 14 component-library defaults (un-themed Bootstrap kit), C15 (nine hex values, no OKLCH, no tokens). Fix: declare one brand accent at least 30 hue degrees away, e.g. `--accent: oklch(0.5 0.11 205)` (white text 5.51:1), derive hover, pressed and border with `oklch(from var(--accent) ...)`, tint the border grey from the same hue, and keep the existing `:focus-visible` ring.

title: Release note text under AA contrast on the white ground
evidence: `.note { color: #8a8a8a; font-size: 14px; }` on the `#ffffff` body measures 3.45:1 against the 4.5:1 AA bar for text under 24px. Fix: keep the neutral and lower its lightness until it clears, e.g. `color: #6b6b6b` (5.33:1).

title: Button, hover and card meta text under AA contrast
evidence: Three declared pairs sit under the 4.5:1 bar: `.btn` white 16px on `oklch(0.68 0.14 75)` = 2.95:1 (line 11), 2.34:1 on its hover `oklch(0.74 0.12 75)` (line 12, the hover gets lighter), and `.card .meta` `#64748b` on `#0f172a` = 3.75:1 (line 15). `.tag` `#6b7280` on `#f1f5f9` = 4.41:1 is within 0.3 of the bar, a note. Fix: keep each hue and move lightness: button fill `oklch(0.48 0.12 75)` (6.65:1) with a darker hover `oklch(0.42 0.12 75)`, meta `#94a3b8` (6.96:1), tag text `#475569` (6.92:1).

title: Cream ground, serif display and sage accent with the screenshot card
evidence: All three legs and the hero that ships with them: cream ground `#faf8f5` (line 8, a listed hex), `'Instrument Serif'` as the primary face (line 10), sage `#15573a` as headline accent and button fill (lines 15, 17), and an empty `aria-hidden` screenshot card on the right (`.shot`, lines 18 and 28). Inter is the lede face (line 16). Fix: anchor colour and type to the real brand or a named reference instead of another tasteful palette; if warm editorial is the stated decision, keep it and mark the line `anti-slop-allow: <reason>`; put the real product in `.shot`.

title: Emoji as status dots, list bullets and button icon
evidence: Seven emoji used as interface chrome, all written as character references: status dots `🟢` / `🟡` / `🔴` in the State column (lines 37-39), list markers `✅` twice and `⚠️` (43-45), and `🚀` inside the deploy button (47). None sits in prose. Fix: keep the state encoding and change its vehicle: an SVG glyph or badge per state in tuned status colours beside the existing text label, SVG check and alert markers on the list, and a plain button label.

title: Fixed 1200px shell with no viewport meta
evidence: No `<meta name="viewport">` in the head; `.shell { width: 1200px; }` (line 15), `.lede { width: 640px; }` (17) and `.lanes { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 360px); }` (18), with fixed px type and no `@media` or `clamp()`. The page overflows horizontally below about 1280px. Fix: add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">`; `.shell { width: min(100% - 2rem, 75rem); padding-block: clamp(2rem, 1rem + 4vw, 4rem); }`; `.lede { max-width: 40rem; }`; `.lanes { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 18rem), 1fr)); }`; `h1 { font-size: clamp(2rem, 1rem + 4vw, 3rem); }`.

title: Middle-dot meta strings on every lane
evidence: Three `A · B · C` meta strings, one per lane (lines 32, 36, 40), e.g. `1,382 mi · $2.41/mi · 62 loads posted`: six spaced middle dots on the surface against a threshold of three instances. Fix: these are three comparable fields per lane, so set them as a `dl` (distance, rate, loads posted) or one table with tabular figures so the values align across lanes; keep the `.rate` accent.

title: Flat-terminal subtraction-only dashboard
evidence: Read from the token map: ground `oklch(0.12 0.003 270)` against panel `oklch(0.13 0.003 270)` is a 1.01:1 tint step, so there is one perceivable surface level (S3); the only boundary on panels and table rows is `--hair: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.08)`, 1.16:1 against the ground and under the 1.3:1 edge bar (S4); no shadow or rim; `--accent: oklch(0.6 0.02 270)` is chroma 0.02 against a 0.10 floor (S2) and appears only as current-nav text at the same lightness as `--dim`, so the current page is visually unmarked (S1); chroma is reserved for `--ok` / `--bad`; system stack at 400 and 600. Fix by adding, not removing: a brand accent at chroma 0.12 or more used as a fill on the current nav item and one key figure; an edge that measures on both surfaces (`oklch(0.3 0.01 270)` is 1.49:1 on this ground) plus a top-edge rim `inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.14)` on raised panels; shard state as a badge with its label.

title: Hero face outside the typography DESIGN.md declares
evidence: `.hero { font-family: "Lobster", cursive; }` (line 13) is a primary face the sibling `DESIGN.md` does not declare: its typography block names `Söhne, system-ui, sans-serif` (lines 7-9) and its prose says Söhne is the one face. `body` (line 9) follows the system; the hero does not. Confirmed against the file. Fix: `.hero { font-family: inherit; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.025em; font-size: clamp(2rem, 1rem + 4vw, 3rem); }` so the display voice comes from Söhne's weight and tracking, or record the exception in DESIGN.md if it was decided.

title: Focus ring bound to :focus on both buttons
evidence: Both buttons carry `focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-600 focus:ring-offset-2` (lines 31, 34) with no `focus-visible:` variant, so the ring paints on mouse click as well as on keyboard focus. An indicator is kept, which makes this U4 and not U3. Fix: `focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-teal-600 focus-visible:ring-offset-2` on both, and the same ring on the `select` (line 24).

title: Frosted-glass sticky nav
evidence: `<nav class="backdrop-blur-md bg-white/70 border-b sticky top-0">`: backdrop blur, translucent white, bottom border and sticky in one run, with a CTA button inside. Aliases: Strongest-10 #2, section 11 frosted-glass navigation bar. Fix: a solid nav on a raised, brand-tinted surface with a real bottom edge, at a height chosen for its content, sticky only if the page is long enough to need it; keep blur only where type must stay legible over moving content.

title: Purple neon glow on the nav CTA
evidence: `.cta { box-shadow: 0 0 40px 6px rgba(168,85,247,.6); }`: a 40px-blur, 6px-spread halo in purple-500 (`#a855f7`, hue 303.9, chroma 0.233, inside the C3 arc) on the nav button, on a light page with no dark-mode need. Alias: C3. Fix: emphasis from a brand fill plus a rim light and a tuned drop, e.g. `box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.25), 0 1px 2px oklch(0.2 0.02 40 / 0.2), 0 6px 16px oklch(0.2 0.02 40 / 0.12);` on a fill outside hue 255-325.

title: Focus outline removed with no focus-visible replacement
evidence: `a:focus, button:focus { outline: none; }` (line 9) with no `:focus-visible` rule anywhere in the stylesheet: the firing-schedule button (line 25) has no visible keyboard focus (WCAG 2.4.7). Fix: delete the rule and add `a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.24 0.01 60); outline-offset: 2px; }`.

title: Purple-to-blue gradient text on the hero headline
evidence: `<h1 class="text-5xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 via-fuchsia-500 to-blue-500 bg-clip-text text-transparent">`: a gradient-clipped headline whose three stops all sit in the AI purple family (purple-600 hue 302.3, fuchsia-500 322.1, blue-500 259.8), over the generic line `Welcome to the platform`. title: Neutral grey text on saturated blue blocks
evidence: Neutral mid-grey text on a chromatic surface, twice: `bg-blue-800 text-gray-300` in one class set (line 16) and `.promo { background: #1e40af; color: #d1d5db; }` (line 10; text chroma 0.009 on a ground at chroma 0.181, hue 265.6). Contrast passes at 5.92:1; the defect is the untinted grey on colour. Fix: tint the text from the surface hue on both, `color: oklch(0.92 0.03 265)` (6.88:1) or Tailwind `text-blue-100` (7.15:1).

title: Verbatim Tailwind hero triplet on the h1
evidence: The hero `h1` carries the exact unmodified run `text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight`, in that order, and the file has no `clamp()`. Aliases: T14, P2. The rest of the page is tuned (its own ink, paper and signal tokens, tabular figures, specific copy), which makes the pasted run stand out. Fix, keeping the size responsive: `h1 { font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 1rem + 5vw, 3.75rem); font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1.05; }`.

title: Camera product page with twelve icon-cards and no image
evidence: A page selling a camera never shows it: 0 `img` / `picture` / `figure` / `video` / `canvas` across 4 sections, against 12 identical icon-cards (a 22px stroke `svg`, an `h3` and a `p` in a bordered `li`, three per section, lines 34-53). title: Icon-only delete button with no accessible name
evidence: `<button class="remove" type="button"><svg ...></svg></button>`: the only child is an `svg`, with no `aria-label` on the button, no visually hidden text and no `<title>`, so the control has no accessible name (WCAG 4.1.2). title: Cream ground with Instrument Serif as the page face
evidence: Two legs of the combination on `body` (line 7): cream ground `#faf8f5` (a listed hex) and `'Instrument Serif'` as the primary face, with Inter for the subtitle (line 8). No accent is declared, so two legs and not three. Fix: anchor ground and type to the real brand or a reference; if warm editorial is a stated decision, keep it and mark the line `anti-slop-allow: <reason>`.

title: Hero headline is a workflow-transformation formula
evidence:
`

Transform your workflow. Effortlessly.

`: the catalogued `Transform the way you...` / workflow formula with no object, number or audience; it stays true under any other product's name. Fix: say what the subtitle already knows with a specific verb and object, e.g. `Plan the whole team's week on one board`, and give the subtitle a concrete proof point.

title: Stock unDraw illustration as the only image
evidence: ``: a stock unDraw flat-vector figure is the page's only image. Fix: a real screenshot of the weekly plan the copy describes, with alt text that says what it shows, or illustration drawn for the brand; not another stock set.

title: Fixed 1180px app shell with asserted columns and 100vh
evidence: `.app-shell { width: 1180px; height: 100vh; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 260px); }` (lines 3, 5, 7): a fixed-pixel shell with an asserted four-column track list and a `100vh` height (alias P3). It overflows below 1180px and sits behind mobile browser chrome. Fix: `width: min(100%, 74rem); margin-inline: auto; min-height: 100dvh; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(16rem, 1fr));`.

title: Pulsing dot beside the Live label and an animate-ping dot
evidence: Two pulsing status dots: `.live-dot` (8px, `border-radius: 50%`) runs `pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite` on opacity and scale beside the text `Live` (lines 11-18, 27), and an `animate-ping` `rounded-full` 8px emerald dot follows `Four people are waiting.` (line 28). The motion is gated for reduced-motion users, which does not change the tell. Fix: content-borne liveness: a static state dot with its label, a `<time>` that updates (`Updated 12 s ago`), and the waiting count changing in place inside an `aria-live="polite"` region.

title: Decorative fuchsia blur blob behind the hero
evidence: `<div class="absolute -z-10 h-72 w-72 rounded-full bg-fuchsia-300 blur-3xl opacity-20">`: the verbatim blur-blob class run, empty and decorative, in a fuchsia tint (hue 321). Fix: the product or a photograph as the hero's focal visual, or a solid brand block; atmosphere, if any, as grain under 0.05.

title: Welcome back greeting as the hero subhead
evidence: `Welcome back! Pick up where the last sync left off.` is the hero subhead under a `Now in beta` label, on a page whose only action is a signup tour. Fix: recognition as data where the visitor is known (`Last sync finished 3 hours ago, 2 conflicts to review`); for a first-time visitor, one sentence saying what Northwind syncs and for whom.

title: Indigo-to-violet gradient on the only call to action
evidence: The page's one action is filled with `bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-violet-600`: indigo-500 (hue 277.1) to violet-600 (hue 293.0), both inside the 255-325 arc at chroma above 0.2. Alias: C5. Fix: one committed brand hue at least 30 degrees outside the arc as a solid fill, e.g. `bg-[oklch(0.58_0.16_40)]` (white text 4.59:1) with derived hover and pressed states; no gradient.

title: shadcn demo revenue stat shipped verbatim
evidence: The shadcn dashboard demo stat, verbatim: `Total revenue`, `$45,231.89`, `+20.1% from last month` (lines 22-24). One card, so the lone-value class applies. Fix: a real figure from the product with real comparison context (against target, against the same week last season), or replace the card with a product screenshot on a marketing page that has no data to show.

title: Percent-change line under AA contrast
evidence: `text-sm text-emerald-600` (`#059669`, 14px) on the inherited `bg-slate-50` page ground (`#f8fafc`) measures 3.60:1 against the 4.5:1 AA bar. Alias: C10, the default success green untuned for its surface. Fix: `text-emerald-700` (`#047857`, 5.24:1), and carry the direction with a sign or arrow glyph as well as colour.

title: Logo marquee that never stops
evidence: `.track { animation: scroll 30s linear infinite; }` carries the logo row to `translateX(-50%)` forever (lines 12-17), with the three logos duplicated to loop (27-29) and no pause control or hover/focus pause (WCAG 2.2.2). The `no-preference` gate protects only readers who asked for less motion. Alias: L8. Fix: a static strip of the three logos in a wrapping flex row at reduced opacity with colour on hover; if it must move, pause on `:hover` and `:focus-within` and add a visible pause button.

title: Invoices table ships only its populated state
evidence: The table has one branch: three rows, all `Paid` (lines 20-29). No empty state, no loading state for the Refresh action, no error state with recovery, no unpaid or overdue status variant, and no `aria-live` region for a refresh result. Fix: design the zero-invoice state first (what to do next, in product voice), then a refresh-in-progress state on the button and table, a failed-refresh message with retry, and status variants carried by label and icon.

title: Refresh button with a TODO for a handler
evidence: `<button onclick="/* TODO: wire refresh */">Refresh</button>`: the handler is a comment, so the page's only control does nothing. Fix: wire it to the invoice fetch with a busy state (`aria-busy`, disabled while pending) and an announced outcome, or remove the button until it works.

title: JetBrains Mono on six talent readouts
evidence: `font-family: var(--font-mono)` (`"JetBrains Mono"`, line 2) on six human-readable readouts: talent level value (line 7), level preset (9), tree points (11), points spent (13), node rank (15) and numeric table cells (17). Each already sets `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`, so the mono face adds only the terminal look. The `white-space: pre` textarea and the readonly input (19-21) hold raw import strings and are legitimate mono. Fix: drop `font-family` from the six readout rules so they inherit `--font-sans`; keep `tabular-nums` and the 600 emphasis weight for alignment and hierarchy.

title: Bounce on the order toast, menu and scroll cue
evidence: Three bounce reflexes on one confirmation page: `.toast` runs `bounce-in`, whose keyframes reverse direction three times (0, -24px, 0, -10px, 0; lines 15, 18-24) on a `role="status"` message; `.menu` transitions with `cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55)`, which both anticipates and overshoots (line 16); the cue arrow carries `animate-bounce` (35). Fix: one settle per element, matched to the message: `.toast { animation: rise 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) both; }` from `translateY(8px)` and opacity 0, `.menu { transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); }`, and a static cue; keep the `no-preference` gate.

title: Three orphan paragraphs between the tiles and the table
evidence: Three paragraphs sit as direct children of `main` between the stat tiles and the invoice table (lines 34-36): 27, 63 and 24 words, the longest over the 60-word single-orphan bar. Their siblings are a tile list and a table, and no heading covers them. Fix: the refresh note becomes the tiles' caption (`Refreshed hourly from the ledger`), the collections explanation becomes the table's caption or a `details` under it (`Why a customer can leave this table`), and the netting rule moves into the headed `How balances are calculated` section at a 45-75ch measure.

title: Three consecutive text-only sections
evidence: `How balances are calculated`, `Payment terms` and `Who to contact` (lines 45-55) are each an `h2` and two paragraphs with no non-text child, 163 words in all on a control surface: a run of 3 against a threshold of 3. Fix: a non-text device every second section, drawn from the content: payment terms as a `dl` or small table (standard net 30, enterprise per contract, fee accrual), contacts as a list of the three routes with links. No added prose.

title: Grid, dot and stripe patterns behind content
evidence: Three decorative patterns: a hairline grid on `body::before` (two 1px linear-gradients at right angles on a 24px tile, lines 13-14), a dot field behind the hero (`radial-gradient(circle, ... 1px, transparent 1px)` on a 16px tile, line 18) and 45-degree repeating stripes behind the promo (line 19). Fix: a solid ground with a measured tone shift between the hero and the promo; keep a grid only where the page is about a grid.

title: Gradient text on one word of the hero headline
evidence: `.accent` sets `linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(0.62 0.15 25), oklch(0.72 0.16 60))` with `background-clip: text; color: transparent` (lines 17-22) on one word of the headline, `reconciled` (line 28), and no `anti-slop-allow` line records it as a brand decision. title: Four paragraphs of prose above the drop table
evidence: 254 words of running prose in four paragraphs (75, 63, 60 and 56 words, lines 40-43) under `About the Thornfang Blade` sit above the page's primary content, the `Drop sources` table (line 47). With the 27-word lede that is 281 words before the first data element against a 40-word budget for a reference page, and two of the paragraphs point at data printed below them; the enchant paragraph promises a table the page does not have. No facts deleted.

title: Saturated cyan radial halo behind the hero
evidence: `.hero { background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.8), transparent 70%); }` on a `#0b0b10` page: a saturated cyan halo (chroma 0.13) at 0.8 alpha fading to transparent, the CSS form of the blur blob. The light `#e5e7eb` heading sits over its brightest zone; contrast over a gradient is not measured statically. title: Colliding headline tracking, tight leading, tracked body and narrow justified text
evidence: Four reading-mechanics defects: `.hero h1 { font-size: 32px; letter-spacing: -0.1em; }` is past the -0.07em floor for type under 40px, so letters collide (line 10); `.article p { line-height: 1.15; }` on a 50-word 16px paragraph (11); `.note p { letter-spacing: 0.12em; }` on mixed-case running text (12); `.sidebar-note { width: 22ch; text-align: justify; }` with no `hyphens: auto` (13). Fix: `h1 { letter-spacing: -0.02em; }`, `.article p { line-height: 1.5; }`, remove the tracking from `.note p`, and `.sidebar-note { text-align: start; }`.

title: Unmodified shadcn Card class run
evidence: `<div class="rounded-lg border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm p-6">`: the shadcn `Card` class run verbatim (pre-v4 radius) with the demo `p-6` and no token or class change. title: Border, radius and shadow-sm on both cards
evidence: 2 of 2 cards on the surface are a padded block with a full 1px border, a radius and `shadow-sm`: line 10 carries the row's literal classes (`shadow-sm hover:shadow-md border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-4`) and line 6 the same trio (`rounded-lg border ... shadow-sm p-6`). Line 10 also has the stock `shadow-sm` to `shadow-md` hover step (D3). title: shadcn init token block shipped untouched
evidence: The `:root` block is the current `shadcn init` neutral scaffold verbatim: `--radius: 0.625rem`, `--background: oklch(1 0 0)`, `--foreground: oklch(0.145 0 0)`, `--primary: oklch(0.205 0 0)`, `--border` and `--input` at `oklch(0.922 0 0)`, `--ring: oklch(0.708 0 0)` (lines 9-19). title: Unmodified current-generation shadcn Card
evidence: `<div class="rounded-xl border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm p-6">`: the verbatim current shadcn `Card` class run with the demo `p-6`, a separate span from the token block. title: Coloured side stripe on five notes in five syntaxes

title: 650ms cross-fade on every route change
evidence: `::view-transition-old(root), ::view-transition-new(root) { animation-duration: 650ms; }` with `@view-transition { navigation: auto; }` (lines 15-17): every navigation between routes cross-fades for 650ms, past the 400ms ceiling for a full-screen transition. title: Save button and hint bypass the token block beside them
evidence: `.save` and `.hint` hardcode values next to the tokens defined at lines 7-15: `background: oklch(0.543 0.104 159)` and hover `oklch(0.5 0.11 160)` beside `--brand: oklch(0.49 0.085 158)` (lines 24, 30); `padding: 11px 17px` beside `--space-300: 12px` (26); `border-radius: 5px` beside `--radius: 6px` (27); `margin-top: 9px` beside `--space-200: 8px` (31); `color: oklch(0.985 0.004 90)` restating `--surface` (25). `.panel` in the same file uses the tokens. title: Running text at 11px and links at 10px
evidence: Three sizes under the legibility floors: `.article p { font-size: 11px; }` on a 43-word paragraph (running-text floor 12px; line 10), `.price-note { font-size: 0.625rem; }` = 10px inside the price sentence (11), and `.footer-nav a { font-size: 10px; }` on links (functional floor 11px; 12). Fix: `.article p { font-size: 1rem; }`, `.price-note { font-size: 0.8125rem; }`, `.footer-nav a { font-size: 0.875rem; }`; get density from spacing, not size.

title: 8px radius on every control
evidence: `border-radius: 8px` on every control: `input, select, textarea` (line 21), `.chip` three times (25) and `button.submit` (27). Seven controls share one radius, the pre-v4 shadcn `--radius`, hardcoded three times with no token. Fix: commit a radius identity in tokens, e.g. `--r-control: 3px; --r-chip: 999px;`, so the fields and submit share the precise radius and the fault chips read as a different kind of control.

title: rounded-full on every control including the textarea
evidence: `rounded-full` on all five control-shaped elements whatever their shape: the text input (line 28), the select (33), a three-row textarea (41), the schedule chip (45) and the submit button (48). On the textarea the pill radius cuts into the text corners. Fix: one small radius (2 to 6px) for the fields and the button, with the pill kept for the chip alone, where it tells a tag from a field.

title: 100vh app with a fixed bottom bar and no safe-area inset
evidence: `.app { height: 100vh; }` (line 16) with a `position: fixed; bottom: 0` action bar (lines 21-22) that has no `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)` padding, and no `viewport-fit=cover` in the viewport meta. On mobile the bar sits under the browser chrome or the home indicator, and it covers the last stop because `.scroll` reserves no space for it. Fix: `.app { height: 100dvh; }`; make `.bar` a flex child (`flex: 0 0 auto`, no `position: fixed`) with `padding-bottom: max(0.75rem, env(safe-area-inset-bottom))`; add `viewport-fit=cover` to the meta.

title: Viewport media query lays out a card used in the rail and the main column
evidence: `@media (min-width: 60rem) { .firing { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9rem 1fr; } }` (lines 30-33) asks the window how wide it is, and `.firing` renders both in the 14-18rem `.rail` (line 40) and in the wide `.main` column (46, 50). From 60rem up the rail copy gets a 9rem label column and, after the 1.5rem gap, 3.5-7.5rem for its text. Fix: `.rail, .main { container-type: inline-size; }` and `@container (min-width: 28rem) { .firing { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9rem 1fr; column-gap: 1.5rem; align-items: baseline; } }`.

title: Viewport meta disables pinch zoom
evidence: `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no">` disables zoom (WCAG 1.4.4). Fix: `content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"`.

title: Positive tabindex on all four search form controls
evidence: Positive `tabindex` on every form control: search `3` (line 18), from `1` (21), to `2` (24), submit `4` (26). Keyboard order becomes from, to, search, submit, against the visual and DOM order, and all four jump ahead of the header link. Fix: remove the four attributes; the DOM order is already correct.
